statement: Every principally polarized sixfold over any algebraically closed field has an integral curve of class six times the minimal class and [6] factors through a product of Jacobians.
depends_on: ADFIO2020 Theorem1/Corollary2 p165; Oort1971 Corollary2.4.2; Fulton1998 Example20.3.5; Matsusaka
notes: Preserves the polarized adjoint identity when transferring from C to arbitrary char0; polarized lifting includes p2 and p3.

statement: Every abelian threefold satisfies s_J(A)|gcd(6,delta(A)); separate polarization checks at2 and3 suffice for an actual direct summand.
notes: Removes prime5 and excess powers of2 from the previous120 bound. Remaining2/3 cases are not claimed solved.
